title: Text: DET Jay Sartori ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I rarely do this, but...I wouldn’t rely on those Trade Rumors arb projections.  They’re terrible...frequently VERY wrong.
That’s off the record- don’t quote me
Yeah I know. Many times, my editors will slip them in as a point of reference
Yesterday night, one put one in and it was $13.8 for nick
Tell them to stop being dumb about it
And his agent called me all pissed
Yeah- it’s good for projecting 100M payrolls within a few million. Not single players.
